message.content: {"reason": "The current 0.7438 accuracy is limited mainly by representation: trees see target-encoded marginals instead of native categorical splits, conjunctive structure such as coupon x time x income x family status is not explicit, and the NN-heavy blend has little real diversity. Historical successful runs show that leakage-free learned preprocessing persisted in a single bundle plus native categorical handling is reliable, while the failed target-encoding-only attempt confirms marginal encoding alone is insufficient. I will therefore refine across all three modules: add explicit interactions/native categorical support, add a decorrelated ExtraTrees member and 3-way OOF blend, and stabilize NN training without changing the official accuracy objective or output contract.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "model_design", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Extend CouponFeatureEngineer to add explicit domain interaction categorical columns: coupon x expiration, coupon x time-of-day bucket, coupon x income bucket, coupon x has_children, and distance x direction-match, fitted only from training data and persisted with the engineer. Also extend the GBDT matrix construction so HistGradientBoostingClassifier receives a native categorical block (integer-coded cat_* and interaction codes) alongside numeric and leakage-free smoothed target-encoding columns, and add a one-hot low-cardinality categorical block for ExtraTrees. WHY: the label depends on conditional coupon acceptance patterns, and the current _prepare_gbdt_matrix drops categorical identity for trees while TE collapses interactions into marginals. HOW: add interaction builders into _raw/fit/transform, include their vocabularies in the same fold-specific TE machinery with m=20 and stored prior, extend feature_names/cat_cols/num_cols consistently, and return a metadata mask identifying categorical GBDT indices. Preserve CouponFeatureEngineer.fit, transform, fit_target_encoding, transform_target_encoding, _prepare_fold, _prepare_gbdt_matrix, and the row_id/output semantics; never fit vocabularies, medians, interactions, or TE maps on prediction data or validation labels.", "model_design": "WHAT: Modify CouponModel and TrainConfig to reduce overfitting and make the NN non-dominant in the blend: apply dropout to the concatenated embedding-vector block before the MLP, add label smoothing 0.05 to CrossEntropyLoss, extend NN seeds from 2/3 to a fixed 4-seed list, and use validation log-loss as the early-stopping criterion while still computing accuracy for reporting. WHY: with about 8k rows and heavy class imbalance, single-fold argmax accuracy is a high-variance epoch selector and can choose overconfident epochs that harm the OOF blend; embedding dropout and label smoothing reduce confidence on rare category combinations. HOW: add embedding-dropout in CouponModel.forward via nn.Dropout on the concat vector, update TrainConfig and _train_one_model to use nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.05), track best validation log-loss with same patience, and preserve the CouponModel constructor/forward signatures and state_dict compatibility through nn_cfg emb_dim/hidden/dropout. Do not change the final task metric: candidate ranking, blend selection, and reported validation remain accuracy-based; log-loss is only an internal training stabilizer.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Add a third structurally different OOF learner, ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators about 400, max_features='sqrt', n_jobs=2), trained per fold on the shared matrix with the one-hot low-cardinality categorical block, and replace the single _search_blend alpha with a non-negative 3-way probability blend (NN, HistGB, ExtraTrees) optimized on OOF accuracy then normalized to sum to 1. Also consolidate the duplicate _save_bundle/_load_bundle/run_predict definitions in the current file so the intended implementation is the one loaded. WHY: HistGB and NN currently make correlated errors on the same collapsed representation, whereas bagged extra trees make decorrelated errors and historical successes show that persisting all fitted state in one bundle prevents fresh-process reload/leakage failures. HOW: train ExtraTrees inside the existing 5-fold RandomState(7) loop on train-only fold rows, collect OOF probabilities, search coarse Dirichlet/grid weights by OOF accuracy, then refit full ExtraTrees and all models; extend _save_bundle with extra_trees_models, blend_weights, gbdt categorical indices, interaction flag, TE maps/prior/m and feature metadata, and make run_predict load these read-only, average fold/model probabilities, apply the stored blend weights, and write row_id,prediction in input order with original labels. Preserve the command-line contract, no refitting at predict time, CPU/2-thread/600s limits, and never use validation or test labels for training or preprocessing."}}
